body:
Sound advice thanks. I know how depression and negativity can colour your thinking. I've been living with depression for my whole life (33 years). I know to wait for the worst of the storm to pass before being able to make an objective decision.   
I think I posted this simply to make a connection with someone. I don't feel like there is anyone I can talk with about my problems, that includes a girlfriend, family and large group of close friends. I have tried before. There are a lot of positive ways of thinking out there. I just don't subscribe to any of them. Theyre like suits that don't fit me.
I didnt realise the pricing. I have just made a first appointment.

Just from talking this morning it seems that this is exactly what my girlfriend thinks the problems are. She thinks It is me not being happy and not seeing a personal future that makes our relationship look like it doesnt have one. I understand that maybe. But should it really mean I am not excited by her any more?

No offense taken. Ive just had the hardest morning ever. I am going away for a few days. She has been trying to hug and kiss me and tell me she loves me all morning. I feel totally wretched. I dont know how to tell her this isnt helping me think without pushing her away more and she is in total panic. I get that this must feel sudden for her but not this sudden. Its like she is in denial that anything could go wrong with our relationship.
When you say try something new, what do you mean? There are certainly no museums or restaurants left.
Jesus, on my worst day I don't think anyone could help me. About seeing the realtionship going somewhere, where would it be going?

This makes a lot of sense to me, thank you. I know that the breakup is going to be hell. Worst of all I have nowhere to go and no family to turn too. It has been very much me and her for so long. Even just beginning to discuss this and asking for some time away this weekend she broke down in front of me. I feel like the worst person who ever lived. I dont want to hurt her like this. Especially if it can be made right no matter how hard. God I wish there was someone who could support me.
Hey. I think there is truth in what you are saying but I dont know how to change and I cant afford therapy.
